options: Check short beneath the midfield line
questions.explain: Yes. Checking beneath Blue's midfield line opens a clear route from the center back.
choiceExplanations: Blue's midfielder stands in that lane, so the pass from the center back would be cut out.

questions.q: True or false? Here the six should move into the same lane as the eight to help him.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The six keeps a different lane, giving the eight another inside connection.
choiceExplanations: In the same lane, one opponent can block both of them. Separate lanes give two passing options.

questions.q: Which picture shows the moment to pass to the fullback?
options: Wing-back in the wide lane, eight unmarked
Wing-back in the wide lane, eight followed
questions.explain: Yes. The wing-back has dropped and the eight drags his marker inside, so the fullback is free.
choiceExplanations: The wing-back still blocks the wide pass, and the eight is free, so play into the checking eight.
